title: [Shopify] Make refund currency codes read-only
summary: Currency Code and Presentment Currency Code fields on the Shopify Refund Header table are now read-only to prevent accidental modification of imported Shopify data.
key_points: Two currency fields on Shopify Refund Header made read-only
Prevents manual editing of imported values from Shopify
Applied at table level for consistent behavior across all pages
No schema or data changes, low risk
quote: Both values are imported from Shopify and should remain consistent with the retrieved refund data.
